data.gender_notes: Ashwini is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, the Ashwini are the celestial twin horses that draw the chariot of the god Indra. The name Ashwini means ‘horse, swift, fleet’ and represents agility, speed, and strength. The name Ashwini carries the meaning “Horse, swift, fleet” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashwini usually hope their child will grow to embody horse, swift, fleet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes swiftness and agility, embodying the qualities of a divine horse.
data.etymology: Ashwini belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Horse, swift, fleet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashwini total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The Ashwini twin horses have significant references in Hindu mythology, texts, symbolism, and traditions. They are worshipped as divine entities, and their names are associated with several traditions and festivals. In some regions of India, the Ashwini name is still used for baby boys born during the Ashwini Nakshatra, which is believed to be an auspicious time for new beginnings. Additionally, Ashwini is the name of a Nakshatra, the lunar mansion, which is the 30th one in the Hindu zodiac, signifying the power and energy of the stars and their influence on human life.
data.spiritual_significance: Ashwini, as per Hindu spiritual beliefs, represents the qualities of energy, vitality, and agility. It is also associated with the broader concept of 'Chaitanyam' or consciousness, as the Ashwini horses are believed to carry the spirit of Indra, who represents power, strength, and rulership. Furthermore, the name Ashwini is considered auspicious and is believed to bring blessings of swiftness, strength, health, and success. During rituals and puja, the deities and symbols associated with Ashwini are revered and prayed to for good health, prosperity, and the blessing of the divine horses to overcome challenges in life.

historical_references.reference: The Ashwini Khiladi are said to be the celestial charioteers of the sun god Surya. According to Hindu mythology, they are the twin horses or twin gods, who draw the chariot of Surya across the sky every day.

In early Hindu texts such as the Rigveda, the Ashwini gods are depicted as divine healers, associated with the recovery from illnesses and injuries. They were believed to have the power to cure diseases and bestow longevity upon individuals.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ashwini, which has its origins in Hindu mythology, is gaining popularity in various modern contexts. On Instagram, there are several accounts dedicated to promoting Ashwini as a name inspired by the Ashwini Kumaras, the twin horse-headed physicians of the gods in Hindu mythology. These accounts often feature beautiful images of horses, health and wellness tips, and inspiration quotes to encourage followers to embrace their unique identity. On LinkedIn, professionals with the name Ashwini can be found in various industries, including healthcare, technology, and finance, reflecting the versatility and adaptability of the name.
